comments:
Sorry, after chatting on slack, I forgot about it.
Thanks for the reminder. The fix will be trivial.

@kdy1 I'm not sure this is actually working, even after updating to `@swc/core 1.1.56`

I've pushed a demo project up here; https://github.com/duncanbeevers/swc-sandbox

* Clone repository
* Install dependencies `npm install`
* Start dev server `npm run webpack-sourcemaps`
* Visit local server http://127.0.0.1:8080
* Open devtools, attempt to view source for `App.tsx`

![2020-06-10 at 2 25 PM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7367/84320268-384e8b80-ab26-11ea-84d4-8f413721669a.png)

Oh... Sorry, I thought I fixed it.
I tested it within swc-loader/exmaple bit I failed to verify source map because of codes related to debugging.

I'm also not clear on when to use the `sourceMap` directive versus `inputSourceMap` and how the `[true, false, `inline`]` values affect the option.

I see `sourceMap` in the `swc-loader` example and `inputSourceMap` elsewhere. I've tried a bunch of combinations without success, but it would be nice to understand what the directives mean and which I should be using.

`inputSourceMap` is related to source map generated by previous pass (e.g. loader).

`sourceMap` is related to how swc put the generated source map with file.
Also `sourceMap: false` make swc not emit source map.
This closed issue has been automatically locked because it had no new activity for a month. If you are running into a similar issue, please create a new issue with the steps to reproduce. Thank you.
